cell.label: Bacterial meningitis suspected. Order CBC, blood culture, skin biopsy (if rash present), empiric antibiotic therapy (third-generation, cephalosporin ± vancomycin) plus dexamethasone.
Signs of increased intracranial pressure (eg, papilledema)?
CT of head. Signs of intracranial pressure?
CSF analysis with specific therapy based on CSF and culture results.

footnotes.footnote: Tunkel AR, Hartman BJ, Kaplan SL, Kaufman BA, Roos KL, Scheld WM, Whitley RJ. Practice guidelines for the management of bacterial meningitis. Clin Infect Dis 2004 Nov 1;39(9):1267–1284.
